translation: I have often said that a good physician and a good minister have equal merit; in sum, they can create life for the people. I am a military man; I know neither ministers nor medicine. Only this: when people have illness, it is no less than if it came from myself. At this time of great upheaval and change, the people have suffered war and fire; if they suffer from hot and intense symptoms, I, having been rashly entrusted with pacification, should especially regard the people as if wounded, and regret that I cannot give everyone a cooling remedy. Since entering Xin'an, I have asked about the hardships of the people, and saw that Master Cheng Yandao, a Confucian by profession who is versed in medicine, has long been broadly giving and saving the multitude. He further obtained the forty volumes of the 《Waitai Miyao》 by Prefect Wang of the Tang dynasty, and carefully corrected and carved them.
